A la izquierda — слева, a la derecha — с: A la izquierda means "on the left", a la derecha "on the right", todo recto "straight on", aquí "here", allí "there". Gira a la izquierda means "turn left".
A sinistra — слева, a destra — справа, d: A sinistra means "on the left", a destra "on the right", dritto "straight", qui "here", là "there". Gira a sinistra means "turn left".
Abbiamo una prenotazione means "we have a booking". C'è...? means "is there...?" Al primo piano means "on the first floor" (the ground floor is piano terra).
Aller — идти, ехать. Je vais, tu vas, il: Aller means to go. Je vais, tu vas, il va. À + le = au, à + la = à la: Je vais à l'école. Je vais au parc.
Alles Gute zum Geburtstag! — с днём рожд: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag! means happy birthday! Frohe Weihnachten! means merry Christmas! Frohes neues Jahr! means happy New Year! Das Geschenk is a present.
Alzarsi — вставать: mi alzo, ti alzi, si: Alzarsi means "to get up": mi alzo, ti alzi, si alza. Lavarsi means "to wash": mi lavo. Fare colazione means "to have breakfast", pranzare "to have lunch", cenare "to have dinner".
Am Morgen — утром, am Tag — днём, am Abe: Am Morgen means in the morning, am Tag during the day, am Abend in the evening, in der Nacht at night. Guten Morgen, guten Tag, guten Abend, gute Nacht.
Amable — добрый, valiente — смелый, list: Amable means "kind", valiente "brave", listo "clever", alegre "cheerful", honesto "honest". Porque means "because".
Anchored keeps a part in place.
Andare means to go: io vado, tu vai, lui va. Vado a scuola means I go to school. Lo zaino is a backpack, la penna a pen.
Aufstehen — вставать: Ich stehe um siebe: Aufstehen means to get up: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf (auf goes to the end). Also frühstücken (have breakfast), zu Abend essen (have dinner).
Bisogna — нужно. Non si deve — нельзя. N: Bisogna means "you need to". Non si deve means "you mustn't". Non ... mai means "never": Non dire mai la password.
Bonjour говорят днём, Salut звучит по-др: Bonjour is said during the day; Salut sounds friendly. Au revoir means goodbye. Merci means thank you, and the reply is De rien (you're welcome). In French a space is put before ! and ?.
Buon compleanno! — с днём рождения! Buon: Buon compleanno! means "happy birthday!" Buon Natale! means "merry Christmas!" Buon anno! means "happy New Year!" Il regalo means "the present".
C'è / ci sono — есть. Tanti alberi — мно: C'è / ci sono means "there is / there are". Tanti alberi means "many trees". Vedo means "I see". Il mare is the sea, il fiume the river, la montagna the mountain, il fiore the flower.
CSS tells the browser what tags look like. A rule is made of a selector (which tags) and properties in curly brackets. Each property ends with a semicolon.
CSS кладут внутрь тега <style> в <head>: CSS goes inside a <style> tag in <head> or into a separate style.css file, which is connected with the line <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">. A separate file is handier: the same style works on all the pages of the site.
Can I have..., please? значит «можно мне: Can I have..., please? is a polite way to ask for something. Please goes at the end of the request. The reply is Here you are.
Can I try it on? — можно примерить? What: Can I try it on? What size? It's too big / too small. Some clothes are plural: these jeans, these shoes.
Can значит «умею» или «могу». I can swim: Can shows that you are able to do something. I can swim. I can't swim. After can, the verb has no -s: she can run.
CanCollide = false позволяет проходить с: CanCollide = false lets you walk through the part, and Transparency makes it see-through. After task.wait(3) the door can be closed again: set CanCollide = true and Transparency = 0 back.
Che ore sono? — который час? Sono le tre: Che ore sono? means "what time is it?" Sono le tre means "it's three o'clock". È l'una means "it's one o'clock". E mezza means "half past": Sono le due e mezza. Alle sette means "at seven".
Chi — кто, cosa — что, dove — где, quand: Chi means "who", cosa "what", dove "where", quando "when", perché "why" (and also "because"!), come "how".
Ciao — и «привет», и «пока». Buongiorno: Ciao means both «hi» and «bye». Buongiorno means good day, arrivederci goodbye. Grazie means thank you, and the reply is prego (you're welcome).
Colecciono... — коллекционирую. Mi sueño: Colecciono... means "I collect...". Mi sueño es... means "my dream is...". Me gusta hacer fotos means "I like taking photos".
Colleziono... — я коллекционирую. Il mio: Colleziono... means "I collect...". Il mio sogno è... means "my dream is...". Mi piace fare foto means "I like taking photos".
Collider описывает форму объекта для сто: A Collider describes the shape of an object for collisions: Box Collider for boxes, Sphere Collider for balls, Mesh Collider for complex models. If the floor has no collider, the cube will fall right through it.
Combien ça coûte ? — сколько это стоит?: Combien ça coûte ? means how much is it? Numbers: onze (11), douze (12), vingt (20), trente (30), cinquante (50), cent (100). Prices in euros: deux euros.
Creo que... / Pienso que... — я думаю, ч: Creo que... / Pienso que... means "I think that...". Estoy de acuerdo means "I agree". No estoy de acuerdo means "I don't agree". Para mí means "in my opinion". Aburrido means "boring".
Ctrl + C копирует, Ctrl + V вставляет, C: Ctrl + C copies, Ctrl + V pastes, Ctrl + X cuts, Ctrl + Z undoes the last action, Ctrl + S saves the file. On Mac computers Cmd is used instead of Ctrl.
Directional Light светит как солнце: оди: A Directional Light shines like the sun: equally on the whole scene. A Point Light is like a light bulb, and a Spot Light like a flashlight. By turning the Directional Light you can make morning, day or sunset.
Dolce значит нежно, Cantabile певуче, Ma: Dolce means gently, Cantabile singingly, Marcato accented.
Dov'è...? — где...? Vicino — близко, lon: Dov'è...? means where is...? Vicino means near, lontano far. In autobus means by bus, in macchina by car, a piedi on foot.
Du musst — ты должен. Du darfst nicht —: Du musst means you must. Du darfst nicht means you mustn't: Du darfst dein Passwort nicht sagen. Nie means never.
Ein — для der и das: ein Hund, ein Pferd: Ein is for der and das: ein Hund, ein Pferd. Eine is for die: eine Katze. Ich habe einen Hund means I have a dog (after haben, ein becomes einen for masculine words).
El — для мужского рода: el padre, el her: El is for masculine words: el padre, el hermano. La is for feminine words: la madre, la hermana. Mi means "my" for both: mi mamá, mi papá.
Elle a les cheveux longs — у неё длинные: Elle a les cheveux longs means she has long hair. Il est grand means he is tall. Il porte des lunettes means he wears glasses. Avoir: j'ai, tu as, il a.
En España — в Испании. Soy de México — я: En España means "in Spain". Soy de México means "I'm from Mexico". Languages are written with a small letter: el español, el inglés. La capital means "the capital".
En France — во Франции (женский род), au: En France means in France (feminine), au Canada in Canada (masculine), aux États-Unis in the USA. Languages are written with a small letter: le français, l'anglais.
En hiver, en été, en automne, но au prin: En hiver, en été, en automne, but au printemps. J'adore means I love. Each season has its activities: en hiver on fait du ski.
En invierno, en primavera, en verano, en: En invierno, en primavera, en verano, en otoño mean "in winter, in spring, in summer, in autumn".
En tren, en avión, en barco, en bici, en: En tren, en avión, en barco, en bici, en coche mean "by train, by plane, by ship, by bike, by car". A pie means "on foot". Coger el tren means "to take the train".
Entschuldigung / Es tut mir leid — извин: Entschuldigung / Es tut mir leid means sorry. Ich wollte dich nicht ärgern means I didn't mean to upset you. Das macht nichts means never mind. Sich vertragen means to make up.
Es gibt viele Bäume — много деревьев. Ic: Es gibt viele Bäume means there are many trees. Ich sehe means I see. Der Berg is a mountain, der Fluss a river, das Meer the sea, die Blume a flower.
Estoy contento (contenta) — я рад(а). Es: Estoy contento (contenta) means "I'm happy". Estoy triste means "I'm sad". Estoy cansado means "I'm tired". Tengo hambre means "I'm hungry".
Flexbox: раскладываем в ряд: Flexbox: laying things out in a row
Futur simple: je serai — я буду, je fera: Futur simple: je serai (I will be), je ferai (I will do), je deviendrai (I will become). Quand je serai grand(e) means when I grow up.
Futuro: sarò — я буду, farò — сделаю, di: Futuro: sarò means "I will be", farò "I will do", diventerò "I will become". Da grande means "when I grow up". L'obiettivo means "the goal".
Futuro: seré — я буду, haré — сделаю, vi: Futuro: seré means "I will be", haré "I will do", viajaré "I will travel". De mayor means "when I grow up". La meta means "the goal".
Fußball spielen — играть в футбол. Ich s: Fußball spielen means to play football. Ich spiele gern means I like playing (gern = gladly). Gewinnen means to win: Wir haben gewonnen! means we won!
Gehen — идти: ich gehe, du gehst, er geh: Gehen means to go: ich gehe, du gehst, er geht. In die Schule gehen means to go to school. Word order: the verb always comes second! Heute gehe ich...
Gentile — добрый, coraggioso — смелый, i: Gentile means "kind", coraggioso "brave", intelligente "clever", allegro "cheerful", onesto "honest". Perché means "because".
Gern после глагола значит «люблю делать»: Gern after a verb means «like doing»: Ich male gern means I like drawing. Lieber means prefer. Am liebsten means like most of all.
Giocare a calcio — играть в футбол. Fare: Giocare a calcio means "to play football". Fare nuoto means "to do swimming". Abbiamo vinto! means "we won!" La squadra means "the team".
Giocare — играть: io gioco, tu giochi, l: Giocare means to play: io gioco, tu giochi, lui gioca. Giochiamo? means shall we play? Giocare a calcio is to play football, giocare con la bambola to play with a doll.
Go straight — иди прямо, turn left — пов: Go straight, turn left and turn right give directions. Here means near you, there means further away.
Go straight — иди прямо. Turn left / tur: Go straight. Turn left / turn right. It's on the left. It's far / it's near.
Good morning — доброе утро, good afterno: Good morning, good afternoon and good evening are greetings; good night is said before bed. In the morning means during the morning.
Größer als — больше чем: Der Elefant ist: Größer als means bigger than: Der Elefant ist größer als der Löwe. Am größten means the biggest. Schnell — schneller — am schnellsten.

Ha i capelli lunghi — у неё длинные воло: Ha i capelli lunghi means "she has long hair". È alto means "he is tall". Porta gli occhiali means "wears glasses". Com'è? means "what is he (she) like?"
Hallo — привет, Guten Tag — добрый день,: Hallo means hi, Guten Tag good afternoon, Tschüss bye, Auf Wiedersehen goodbye. Danke means thank you, and the reply is Bitte (you're welcome).
Happy birthday! — с днём рождения! Merry: Happy birthday! Merry Christmas! Happy New Year! A present or a gift is something you give.
Hay muchos árboles — много деревьев. Veo: Hay muchos árboles means "there are many trees". Veo means "I see". El mar is the sea, el río the river, la montaña the mountain, la flor the flower.
Hay que... — нужно. No hay que / no se d: Hay que... means "you need to". No hay que / no se debe means "you mustn't". Nunca means "never": Nunca digas tu contraseña.
Hello говорят в любое время, Hi звучит п: Hello is said at any time; Hi sounds friendly. Bye or Goodbye is said when leaving. Thank you means «thank you», and the reply is You're welcome.
Hola — привет, adiós — пока. Buenos días: Hola means "hello", adiós means "bye". Buenos días means "good morning". Gracias means "thank you", de nada means "you're welcome". A Spanish question begins with an upside-down mark: ¿Qué tal?
How many значит «сколько». Если предмето: How many asks about a number. If there is more than one thing, -s is added to the word: one cat, two cats. Age is said like this: I am five (years old).
How much is it? значит «сколько это стои: How much is it? asks the price. Numbers 13–19 end in -teen: thirteen, fifteen. Tens end in -ty: twenty, thirty, fifty. 100 is one hundred.
I am happy — я радостный, I am sad — мне: I am happy, I am sad. Very makes it stronger: I am very tired. To ask, people say: Are you OK?
I feel good — я хорошо себя чувствую, I: I feel good, I feel ill. My ... hurts says where the pain is. What's the matter? asks what happened.
I have значит «у меня есть». I have a ba: I have means «something belongs to me». I have a ball. Numbers after five: six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
I like значит «мне нравится», I don't li: I like says what you enjoy, I don't like what you don't. After like, the word is put in the plural: I like apples.
I think that... — я думаю, что... I agre: I think that... I agree. I don't agree. In my opinion... Comparing: more interesting.
I want to be a... tells your dream job. A or an goes before a job: a doctor, an artist. What do you want to be?
I want to buy... — я хочу купить... It's: I want to buy... says what you'd like to get. It's expensive, it's cheap. This is for something close, that for something far away.
I значит «я» и всегда пишется с большой: I means «me, myself» and is always written with a capital letter. You means «you» (one person or several). I am = I'm, you are = you're. My name is... means «I am called...».
Ich bin froh — я рад. Ich bin traurig —: Ich bin froh means I'm glad. Ich bin traurig means I'm sad. Ich bin müde means I'm tired. Ich habe Hunger means I'm hungry (literally «I have hunger»).
Ich finde... / Ich denke, dass... — я ду: Ich finde... / Ich denke, dass... means I think that... Ich bin einverstanden means I agree. Meiner Meinung nach means in my opinion. Langweilig means boring, spannend exciting.
Ich habe Kopfschmerzen — у меня болит го: Ich habe Kopfschmerzen means I have a headache. Mir tut der Bauch weh means my tummy hurts. Plural: die Augen (eyes), die Hände (hands).
Ich hätte gern... / Ich möchte... — я бы: Ich hätte gern... / Ich möchte... means I would like. Zum Nachtisch means for dessert. Die Rechnung, bitte means the bill, please. Guten Appetit! means enjoy your meal!
Ich hätte gern... / Ich nehme... — я воз: Ich hätte gern... / Ich nehme... means I'll have... Das schmeckt lecker! means it's delicious! Die Rechnung, bitte means the bill, please.
Ich mag — я люблю (нравится). Ich mag ke: Ich mag means I like. Ich mag keinen Käse means I don't like cheese. Kein means «no, not any», and German often uses it to say «not».
Ich möchte ... kaufen — хочу купить. Das: Ich möchte ... kaufen means I want to buy. Das ist teuer means it's expensive, das ist billig it's cheap. Ich nehme das means I'll take this.
Ich möchte ... werden means I want to become... No article is needed before a job: Sie ist Ärztin. The feminine often ends in -in: Lehrer — Lehrerin, Koch — Köchin.
Ich möchte — я бы хотел (вежливо). Bitte: Ich möchte means I would like (polite). Bitte means please, danke thank you. Plural: Bananen, Erdbeeren, Orangen.
Ich sammle... — я собираю. Mein Traum is: Ich sammle... means I collect. Mein Traum ist es, ... zu sehen means my dream is to see... Ich fotografiere gern means I like taking photos.
Ich ziehe... an — я надеваю (частица an: Ich ziehe... an means I put on (the particle an goes to the end!): Ich ziehe meine Jacke an. Ich trage means I wear.
Ich — я, du — ты. Ich bin — я есть, du b: Ich means I, du means you. Ich bin means I am, du bist you are. Ich heiße... means my name is... Nouns in German are always written with a capital letter: der Junge, das Mädchen.
Il faut — нужно. Il ne faut pas — нельзя: Il faut means you must. Il ne faut pas means you mustn't. Ne ... jamais means never: Ne donne jamais ton mot de passe.
Il y a — есть, имеется: Dans ma chambre,: Il y a means there is: Dans ma chambre, il y a un lit. Dans means in, sur on, sous under.
Il y a — есть. Beaucoup de — много: beau: Il y a means there is. Beaucoup de means a lot of: beaucoup de fleurs. On voit means you can see. The verb voir: je vois, tu vois.
Il — для мужского рода: il papà, il frat: Il is for masculine words: il papà, il fratello. La is for feminine: la mamma, la sorella. Mio means my (masc.), mia my (fem.); with family members the article is often dropped: mia mamma.
Im Winter, im Frühling, im Sommer, im He: Im Winter, im Frühling, im Sommer, im Herbst mean in winter, spring, summer, autumn. Word order: Im Sommer schwimmen wir (the verb comes second!).
In Deutschland — в Германии. Aus Italien: In Deutschland means in Germany. Aus Italien means from Italy. Languages: Deutsch, Englisch, Französisch. Die Hauptstadt is the capital.
In Italia — в Италии, dalla Francia — из: In Italia means "in Italy", dalla Francia means "from France". Sono italiano (italiana) means "I'm Italian". Languages are written with a small letter: l'italiano, il francese. La capitale means "the capital".
In inverno, in primavera, in estate, in: In inverno, in primavera, in estate, in autunno mean "in winter, in spring, in summer, in autumn". D'estate also means "in summer".
In treno, in aereo, in nave, in bici, in: In treno, in aereo, in nave, in bici, in macchina mean "by train, by plane, by ship, by bike, by car". A piedi means "on foot". Prendo il treno means "I take the train".
In, on and under show where things are: The cat is on the table. The ball is under the bed.
In — в, auf — на, unter — под. Die Katze: In means in, auf on, unter under. Die Katze ist unter dem Tisch means the cat is under the table. Es gibt means there is: Es gibt ein Bett.
Input.GetAxis(\"Horizontal\") возвращает: Input.GetAxis("Horizontal") returns a number from −1 to 1: −1 when the left arrow or A is pressed, 1 when right or D is pressed, 0 if nothing is pressed. "Vertical" works the same way for the up and down arrows.
Instantiate создаёт копию префаба во вре: Instantiate creates a copy of a prefab during the game. That's how bullets, enemies and coins appear in random places.
Io — я, tu — ты. Io sono — я есть, tu se: Io means I, tu means you. Io sono means I am, tu sei you are. Mi chiamo... means my name is... Un bambino is a boy, una bambina a girl.
Ir — идти: voy, vas, va. Voy al colegio: Ir means "to go": voy, vas, va. Voy al colegio means "I go to school" (a + el = al). La mochila is a backpack, el bolígrafo a pen.
J'ai mal au ventre — болит живот. Je sui: J'ai mal au ventre means I have a tummy ache. Je suis malade means I'm ill. Il faut... means you must...: Il faut prendre un médicament. Je me sens bien means I feel good.
J'ai mal à... — у меня болит... J'ai mal: J'ai mal à... means ... hurts. J'ai mal à la tête means I have a headache. À + le = au: J'ai mal au nez. Plural: les yeux, eyes (one: l'œil).
J'aime + глагол целиком: J'aime dessiner: J'aime + the whole verb: J'aime dessiner means I like drawing. Mon passe-temps préféré means my favourite pastime. Souvent means often, parfois sometimes.
J'aime — я люблю, je n'aime pas — я не л: J'aime means I like, je n'aime pas means I don't like. The negative wraps around the verb: ne ... pas. After aime you put le, la, les: J'aime le fromage.

JavaScript оживляет страницу. Атрибут on: JavaScript brings a page to life. The onclick attribute of a button says what to do when it is clicked. The alert command shows a little window with a message.
Je collectionne... — я коллекционирую. M: Je collectionne... means I collect. Mon rêve, c'est de... means my dream is to... J'aime + infinitive: j'aime prendre des photos.
Je mets means I put on. Je porte means I wear. Mon for masculine (mon bonnet), ma for feminine (ma robe), mes for plural (mes chaussures).
Je pense que... — я думаю, что... Je sui: Je pense que... means I think that... Je suis d'accord means I agree. Je ne suis pas d'accord means I don't agree. À mon avis means in my opinion. Plus intéressant means more interesting.
Je peux essayer ? — можно примерить? Que: Je peux essayer ? means can I try it on? Quelle taille ? means what size? C'est trop grand / trop petit means it's too big / too small. Il y a des soldes means there's a sale.
Je prends le train — я еду на поезде. En: Je prends le train means I take the train. En avion, en bateau, en voiture, but à vélo, à pied (on foot).
Je suis content — я рад (девочка: conten: Je suis content means I'm happy (a girl says contente). Je suis triste means I'm sad. J'ai faim means I'm hungry (literally «I have hunger»). Je suis fatigué(e) means I'm tired.
Je veux être... — я хочу быть... Перед п: Je veux être... means I want to be... No article is put before a job: Il est médecin. Feminine forms: cuisinier — cuisinière, chanteur — chanteuse.
Je voudrais / je prends — я возьму. Un j: Je voudrais / je prends means I'll have. Un jus d'orange is orange juice. C'est délicieux ! means it's delicious! L'addition is the bill.
Je voudrais acheter... — я хотел бы купи: Je voudrais acheter... means I would like to buy... C'est cher means it's expensive, ce n'est pas cher it's not expensive. Je prends ça means I'll take this.
Je voudrais — я бы хотел (вежливо). S'il: Je voudrais means I would like (polite). S'il vous plaît is please (to an adult), s'il te plaît to a friend. Lots of fruit: des fraises, des bananes.
Je voudrais... — я бы хотел. Comme entré: Je voudrais... means I would like. Comme entrée / plat / dessert means as a starter / main course / dessert. L'addition, s'il vous plaît means the bill, please.
Je — я, tu — ты. Перед гласной je станов: Je means I, tu means you. Before a vowel je becomes j': j'ai. Je m'appelle... means my name is... Je suis... means I am... Un garçon is a boy, une fille is a girl.
Jouer — играть. Je joue, tu joues, il jo: Jouer means to play. Je joue, tu joues, il joue all sound the same! On joue ? means shall we play? Jouer au ballon is to play ball, jouer à la poupée to play with dolls.
